opportunities.name: AA.com flight status lookup by flight number
opportunities.description: On aa.com, open the Flight status tab, search by flight number for a given flight number and date.
steps: Select 'Flight number' as the search mode
Type the flight number into the Flight number field
Open the Date dropdown and pick the travel date

opportunities.name: Amtrak deals filtered by region
opportunities.description: On amtrak.com, open Deals > Deals & Promotions and filter the displayed deals to a chosen region.
steps: Click the 'Display deals in' region selector (All Regions)
Select the target region radio option

opportunities.name: FlightAware Products menu to product pricing/compare page
opportunities.description: On flightaware.com, open the Products menu, go to a given product page and open its plan-comparison/upgrade view.
steps: Choose the target product (e.g. AeroAPI or subscriptions)
Click the compare button ('Compare Tiers Now' / 'Compare Subscriptions')
Optionally click Upgrade on the desired tier
